note: What a partner actually builds on and demos. `platform` is the thing the service runs on; `agents` are pre-built agents a partner can show a client next week rather than describe. `for` is matched against the function a line sits in.

platform.name: Agent Studio
platform.does: Build, test and run the agents, with the workflow and the integrations around them

platform.name: Architect
platform.does: Build agents and apps in one flow, including by describing them, so a business user can shape the workflow

platform.name: OpenController
platform.does: Register every agent, apply policy centrally, and keep the audit trail

platform.name: Responsible AI
platform.does: Evaluation, guardrails and the evidence a risk function asks for

platform.name: Hallucination Manager
platform.does: Catch and score wrong answers before they reach the client's user

platform.name: Knowledge Base
platform.does: Ground the agents in the client's own documents and records

platform.name: Knowledge Graph
platform.does: Hold the relationships between entities when the answer spans several records

platform.name: AI Agent Memory
platform.does: Carry context across a long-running case rather than a single exchange

platform.name: Lyzr Optimus
platform.does: Run the agents, models and governance on an appliance inside their own data centre, air-gapped

platform.name: Sovereign AI
platform.does: Deploy where the data is required to stay, including on-premise and in-country

platform.name: Agents as a Service
platform.does: Lyzr runs the agents so the partner sells the outcome rather than the infrastructure

platform.name: Orchestration as a Service
platform.does: Coordinate agents across systems the client already runs
